# Paths that always run the FundingCAPTCHA (shader) tests in full, with
# pytest-testmon selection off. Read by ci-changes.sh; tested by
# scripts/test_ci_changes.py.
#
# testmon selects shader tests by the Python code each test executed. It cannot
# see anything else, so list here what a shader test depends on that is not
# Python code it runs:
#   - data files the tests read at run time (GLSL, Setup JSON, images, settings)
#   - what decides the test environment: dependencies, pytest config, the CI
#     workflow and the selection scripts themselves
# A Python package testmon already tracks may be listed too, to run the shader
# tests whenever it changes regardless of what testmon recorded.
#
# One glob per line, matched against the whole repo-relative path with bash
# pattern matching: `*` also matches `/`, so `dir/*` covers everything under
# dir. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# Data the shader tests read.
ShowControl/FundingCAPTCHA/shaders/*
ShowControl/FundingCAPTCHA/images/*
ShowControl/FundingCAPTCHA/videos/*
ShowControl/FundingCAPTCHA/*.json
ShowControl/network.json

# The test environment.
pyproject.toml
uv.lock
.python-version
Makefile
.github/workflows/tests.yml
.github/workflows/testmon-data.yml
.github/scripts/*

# Example: run the shader tests on any change to IIVision, not only on the
# code testmon saw them execute.
# IIVision/*
